title: Embed backfill leaves routes permanently incomplete with empty queues — and health=ok at 0% coverage
wanted_capability: Embed coverage that converges to ~1.0, and a health calculation that flags when it doesn't. Live 2026-06-13: git_message 0.000 (45 sources, 0 indexed), notes 0.684 (5,591 unembedded), agent_manifest 0.907, knowledge 0.921, code 0.932 — ALL with queue_depth=0, retried_count=0, health=ok. Empty queue + incomplete coverage means the backfill scheduler is not enqueueing the residue (or the items fail silently before the queue); health=ok at 0% coverage means the gap is invisible to bbox_embed_status consumers. transcripts route reports coverage_ratio=null, indistinguishable from broken. Wanted: (a) diagnose why residue never enqueues (likely per-route backfill cursor/throttle or guarded-content skip without accounting), (b) health_reason flags coverage below threshold with idle queue, (c) transcripts route reports its guarded/disabled state explicitly instead of null. Same silent-maintenance class as gap-1168b0bd and the journal-compaction wedge.
fallback_used: None yet; bbox_reembed per route is the manual lever.
